title: Bound new atomic JSON outputs by recovery limits before publication
description: test/vectors/atomic_json.py bounds existing targets and recovery artifacts at 64 MiB but never bounds each newly encoded document. atomic_write_json_batch can publish an arbitrarily large target, exhausting memory/disk and creating an artifact that its next transaction refuses to back up or recover. Enforce per-artifact and aggregate encoded-byte limits before creating staging files or publishing a journal, ensure the selected bounds guarantee rollback readability, and add oversized single/batch tests proving no files or journal are changed.
